name: Sunrider Legends Tactics
source: The Sunrider series returns in a new fantasy universe! Both new and returning players can embark on this adventure on the high seas. Become a naval captain in the age of sail and command your fleet in tactical turn-based battles.
translation: 仙妮蕾德系列在新的奇幻宇宙中回归！新玩家和回归玩家都可以踏上公海冒险之旅。成为航海时代的海军船长，在战术回合制战斗中指挥你的舰队。
